result.transcript: Faisal Nawaz ne pichle mahine kitne logon ko paise bheje?

cypher_attempts.query:
MATCH (r:Remitter)-[:SENT]->(t:Transfer)-[:TO]->(a:Account)-[:AT]->(b:Bank)
WHERE toLower(r.name) CONTAINS toLower('Faisal Nawaz')
  AND t.ts >= datetime('2026-10-01T00:00:00Z')
  AND t.ts < datetime('2026-11-01T00:00:00Z')
RETURN r.rmid AS rmid,
       count(DISTINCT a.iban) AS beneficiaries,
       count(DISTINCT b.code) AS banks,
       sum(t.amount_pkr) AS total_pkr,
       collect(DISTINCT a.iban) AS ibans
LIMIT 200
